backup.production_rule: Replaces one RLS policy on app_settings with two (staff read the public keys, an owner or admin reads the rest and writes, admin_pin_hash is never writable through the API) and recreates inventory_human_authorized without its stale aal2 line. No table, column or row is changed. Apply within one hour of the restore point.

forward_verification.name: open_staff_policy_is_gone
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'app_settings' and policyname = 'auth all'

forward_verification.name: three_policies_on_app_settings
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'app_settings'

forward_verification.name: anon_policy_untouched
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'app_settings' and policyname = 'anon select public' and cmd = 'SELECT'

forward_verification.name: inventory_gate_is_security_definer_with_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.inventory_human_authorized(uuid)'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: always (restores the previous policy and function body; not recommended, it re-opens the hole)

compatibility.evidence: No front end writes app_settings with a staff JWT (grep 2026-09-17); Edge Functions use the service role. Rehearse on Alfred with supabase/tests/database/settings_lock_and_inventory_aal.sql before apply.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
